mapper.select: SELECT mission_id AS id, title, description, mission_type AS missionType, trigger_event AS triggerEvent, target_count AS targetCount, reward_points AS rewardPoint, auto_complete AS autoComplete, created_at AS createdAt FROM mission
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission (title, description, mission_type, trigger_event, target_count, reward_points, auto_complete) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{missionType}, #{triggerEvent}, #{targetCount}, #{rewardPoint}, #{autoComplete})
mapper.update: UPDATE mission SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, mission_type = #{missionType}, trigger_event = #{triggerEvent}, target_count = #{targetCount}, reward_points = #{rewardPoint}, auto_complete = #{autoComplete} WHERE mission_id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO mission_image (mission_id, origin_name, saved_name, file_path) VALUES
(#{image.missionId}, #{image.originName}, #{image.savedName}, #{image.filePath})
INSERT INTO mission_progress (user_id, mission_id, status, current_count, progress) SELECT #{userId}, mission_id, 'READY', 0, 0 FROM mission;
mapper.select: SELECT mp.id AS userMissionId, mp.user_id AS memberId, mp.mission_id AS missionId, mp.status, mp.current_count AS progressCount, mp.reward_received AS rewardReceived, mp.completed_at AS completedAt, m.target_count AS targetCount, m.title, m.description, m.reward_points AS rewardPoint FROM mission_progress mp JOIN mission m ON mp.mission_id = m.mission_id WHERE mp.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission_post (user_mission_id, title, content, created_at) VALUES (#{userMissionId}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE mission_progress SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'DONE' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'DONE' END, progress = CASE WHEN status = 'DONE' THEN 0 ELSE 100 END, completed_at = CASE WHEN status = 'DONE' THEN NULL ELSE NOW() END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND mission_id = #{missionId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mission_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DONE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_history (user_id, mission_id, point, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{missionId}, #{point}, #{reason}, NOW())
